title: Command Palette Dock does not remember selected Network Adapter
author: mattlaverick-yuga

status.label: Fix committed
status.detail: The network-adapter persistence report predates 0.101 and is covered by merged Command Palette PR #49678.

next_action.label: Monitor shipped fix
next_action.reason: No new 0.101 regression work is needed unless a reporter confirms failure after the CmdPal 0.12 / PowerToys 0.101 fix.

judgment.rationale: The issue merely mentions 0.101 as the expected fixed version; current evidence points to a committed fix, not a fresh 0.101 regression.
evidence: The original report is for PowerToys 0.100.1 and says Command Palette Dock does not remember the selected network adapter after restart.
The issue has label Resolution-Fix Committed.
Maintainer comment says this should be better after #49678, shipping in CmdPal 0.12 / PowerToys 0.101.
PR #49678 is merged and rewrites network statistics/default adapter selection with tests.
judgment.recommended_action: Keep as handled by #49678; re-open design only if new post-0.101 evidence says the fix did not resolve it.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette Dock did not retain or consistently select the intended network adapter, but maintainers have already tied the issue to a merged network-stats/default-selection fix for the 0.101 train.
known_information: Commenters linked related network-stat behavior, including #47430 and duplicate #50022.
zadjii-msft stated #49678 should improve this in CmdPal 0.12 / PowerToys 0.101.
The issue is labeled Resolution-Fix Committed.
inferences: The 0.101 mention is a fix-version reference, not evidence that 0.101 introduced the bug.
If users still reproduce after the fixed CmdPal release, the issue would need fresh reproduction details against that build.
issue_context.analysis: The strongest current signal is a merged upstream fix and a fix-committed label. A dashboard design would duplicate already-merged Command Palette work.
initial_investigation: PR #49678 merged on 2026-08-08 and changed NetworkStats, PhysicalNetworkInterfaceSnapshotProvider, SettingsManager, and NetworkStatsTests.
The PR diff states it replaces performance counters with a GetIfTable2 snapshot and adds aggregate physical-adapter statistics.
Search found related issue #50022 closed as part of dedupe/fix activity.
